catalog.holdout_scope: conditional evaluation at a training-frozen feasible UB and named policy; no capacity probe multiplication

proof_semantics.B6_actual: separate shared execution evaluation; never a planning UB certificate
proof_semantics.LB: same-contract all-causal-policy lower-bound proof; resource task unknown
proof_semantics.UB_B6: complete separate causal planning-track witnesses; not actual shared execution
proof_semantics.UB_N_C_J: complete training causal policy and actual-grid witnesses

catalog.training_b6_actual_scope: conditional separate shared-policy execution at a frozen training planning UB; no substitute exogenous capacity or D-grid multiplication
catalog.training_scope: offline LB contributions without D probes; UB-only grid-point witnesses; not required executions or a capacity-search algorithm

family_disposition.holdout: conditional evaluation lacks an eligible training UB; not holdout infeasibility
family_disposition.training_b6_actual: conditional evaluation lacks an eligible training planning UB; not actual execution failure
family_disposition.training_lb: other pair contributions unnecessary for this whole-cell contradiction; not individual pair infeasibility
family_disposition.training_ub: no complete full-support UB at any registered D for this cell
